title: Finish a song source
prompt: `ISongSource` and `Sources` are supplied. Finish `FixedSource` so that `Name` is `"fixed"` and `Titles()` returns the titles passed to the constructor, in the same order. The class must keep naming `ISongSource`, so it can be used wherever a song source is expected.
hints: The constructor receives the titles. Where are they kept so Titles() can return them later?
Add a property for the list, store the parameter in it in the constructor, and return it from Titles().
Keep : ISongSource on the class line and make Name return "fixed".
support: static ISongSource Source(params string[] titles) => (ISongSource)(object)new FixedSource(titles.ToList());
checkLabels: FixedSource must work as an ISongSource, and its Name must be "fixed".
Titles() must return the titles given to the constructor, in order.
A source created with no titles must return an empty list.
Two sources with 2 and 1 titles must total 3.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Has matching members but never names the interface.
Never stores the titles the constructor receives.

feedback: An InvalidCastException means the class does not name ISongSource. Otherwise, follow the titles from the constructor to Titles() and find where they are lost.
